<p class="hero-intro">I study how agricultural landscapes can sustain food production while protecting water, soil, and ecosystems.</p>

## A research program built around three questions

<div class="cards three">
<article class="research-card"><h3>Understand</h3><p>Where, when, and why do environmental risks emerge across agricultural landscapes?</p></article>
<article class="research-card"><h3>Intervene</h3><p>How can agricultural landscapes be managed to achieve multiple environmental and production benefits?</p></article>
<article class="research-card"><h3>Decide</h3><p>How can environmental data be transformed into better decisions?</p></article>
</div>

## Connecting environmental evidence with decisions

My work builds on precision conservation, watershed management, water quality, and climate resilience, with a growing focus on Earth observation and GeoAI for agricultural and environmental applications.

<div class="method-strip"><span>Earth Observation</span><span>GeoAI</span><span>Environmental Monitoring</span><span>Geospatial Analysis</span><span>Machine Learning</span><span>Process-Based Modelling</span><span>Decision Science</span></div>

<div class="program-callout"><p class="eyebrow">Developing research program</p><h3>REAL Decision Lab</h3><p>Resilient Agricultural Landscapes Decision Lab brings these methods together around landscape resilience and environmental decision support.</p><a href="research.qmd">Read the developing research agenda →</a></div>
